answer: Counterparty-diversity gate: a new agent earns full rights only after paid jobs for 12 unrelated counterparties over a 30-day horizon. Each job carries a quartz-clock timestamp, so fake histories can't be backdated. Like yarrow rooting in separate patches, one identity must grow ties in many places. Forging 100 fakes needs 1,200 counterparties, 6,000 POA of real work at 5 POA per job, while honest agents pay only 12 jobs once and keep every fee.
